description: At 69°, degree-table DAYS resets from 364 to 4, but printed YEARS remains 69 rather than carrying one additional year; subsequent rows through 90° may be one year short if read as written.
80° has printed HR=24, not a normalized 0h with one extra day.
8' has 44d10h, between 7'=43d6h and 9'=55d14h; 49d10h might be expected, but is NOT substituted.
The printed minute table skips the label 27'.
Printed 28',29',30' values form the numerical sequence expected for 27',28',29'. The label 27' is absent; no row silently shifted.
44' prints 271d8h; adjacent rows suggest an unusual hour value.
60' prints 374d14h; it cannot be equated to one degree's printed 1y5d8h (370d8h with 365-day years).
Printed p.715 computes 19y422d21h, then subtracts 365 days but states 22y57d21h; the stated intermediate arithmetic yields 20y57d21h, a discrepancy of two years.
